title: Optimizers
motto: Gradient descent tells you which direction to move. It says nothing about how far or how fast. SGD is a compass. Adam is GPS with traffic data.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: Gradient descent tells you which direction to move. It says nothing about how far or how fast. SGD is a compass. Adam is GPS with traffic data.

steps.title: Why this matters
cards: You computed the gradients. You know that weight #4,721 should decrease by 0.003 to reduce the loss. But 0.003 in what units? Scaled by what? And should you move the same amount on step 1 as on step 1,000?
Vanilla gradient descent applies the same learning rate to every parameter on every step: w = w - lr * gradient. This creates three problems that make training neural networks painful in practice.

steps.title: The concept
steps.body: SGD + momentum accumulates velocity. Adam adapts per-parameter learning rates — default for transformers.

steps.title: Implement optim
steps.body: Write the function from scratch in the workspace. Run when ready — all tests must pass.
